details: Solana is implementing its "Alpenglow" upgrade today, October 21, 2026, which is expected to drastically improve transaction finality from approximately 12.8 seconds to just 150 milliseconds. This significant network overhaul replaces the TowerBFT voting mechanism with Votor, eliminating on-chain vote transactions from blocks and enhancing network efficiency and speed.
title: Solana Undergoes Major Alpenglow Upgrade for Faster Transactions

details: The crypto market saw modest gains on October 21, with Bitcoin (BTC) rising 0.9% to around $82,702 and Ethereum (ETH) up 1.5% to approximately $2,442. The global crypto market capitalization increased by 1.6% to $2.88 trillion, with the Fear and Greed Index indicating a shift to "Greed." Despite a cautious trading environment influenced by global economic uncertainties, major cryptocurrencies maintained key price levels.
title: Bitcoin and Ethereum Show Modest Gains Amidst Market Stabilization

details: Ethereum staking reached a record 43.8 million ETH in Q3 2026, representing 35.9% of the total supply. However, annualized staking yields fell to 2.63% from 2.81% in Q2. This decline is attributed to a larger pool of staked ETH and reduced execution rewards from transaction fees and Maximal Extractable Value (MEV).
title: Ethereum Staking Hits Record Highs, But Yields Decline

details: Ethereum spot Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced a net outflow of $26.13 million on October 20, marking the fifth consecutive day of withdrawals. Fidelity's FETH and Grayscale's Ethereum Mini Trust ETF (ETH) recorded modest inflows, but these were outweighed by broader outflows from other Ethereum spot ETFs.
title: Ethereum Spot ETFs Record Fifth Consecutive Day of Outflows

details: JPMorgan Asset Management has released its first 10-year forecast for Bitcoin, projecting an annual return of 10%. This outlook surpasses their estimates for US large-cap stocks (7.5%) and gold (5.5%), signaling a favorable long-term investment case for Bitcoin compared to traditional assets.
title: JPMorgan Forecasts 10% Annual Return for Bitcoin Over 10 Years
